h1: Electrician in West Palm Beach, FL
intro: West Palm Beach is the oldest incorporated city in the county, dating to 1894, and its neighborhoods carry that history in genuinely old housing, bungalows in Northwood, El Cid, and Flamingo Park. That age means original fuse boxes and obsolete equipment still turn up a short walk from downtown. We work up here often, and we come out, look in person, and give you one honest price.
housingNotes: West Palm Beach is the oldest incorporated city in the county, and Northwood, El Cid, and Flamingo Park carry old housing from the early to mid 20th century. Original fuse boxes and early breaker panels turn up, along with brands the industry no longer considers safe. Near the waterfront, salt air corrodes lugs and terminations, so a panel here wears faster than inland. Many older homes have pools added decades later, so their bonding and grounding deserves a fresh look.
permitNote: In West Palm Beach, service changes and pool electrical corrections need a permit through the city's building division under the Florida Building Code. That keeps a licensed contractor and an inspector between you and a costly mistake. Ghost Crown Electric pulls the permit in our own name and meets the inspector in person.

challenges.heading: Genuinely old housing stock
challenges.body: Neighborhoods like Northwood, El Cid, and Flamingo Park hold homes built in the early to mid 20th century, so fuse boxes, early breaker panels, and obsolete brands still turn up. Our crew knows what is usually behind the cover before it comes off.

challenges.heading: Salt air near downtown and the waterfront
challenges.body: Homes near downtown West Palm Beach and the Intracoastal sit in steady salt air, which corrodes the lugs, bus bars, and terminations inside a panel over the decades. A corroded connection runs hotter than it should, and heat wears a panel out early.

challenges.heading: Pools added long after the original build
challenges.body: Many of West Palm Beach's older homes had pools added well after the house was built, and the bonding and grounding on those additions can loosen or corrode over the years. A yearly pool electrical inspection before heater season catches those issues early.

faqs.question: Do you serve West Palm Beach day or night?
faqs.answer: Yes. West Palm Beach is the northern anchor of our reach, and we answer the phone day or night, wherever you sit in the city. After-hours and emergency visits carry a premium we tell you plainly before we roll, and you reach a licensed electrician, not a call center.

faqs.question: My historic West Palm Beach home had its panel flagged. What now?
faqs.answer: That is common in neighborhoods like Northwood, El Cid, and Flamingo Park. Send us the notice or the 4-point report and we will read it with you. Usually the fix is a modern, code-compliant panel that passes inspection, and we pull the permit and meet the inspector so the objection gets cleared.

faqs.question: How old does a panel need to be before it is a real concern?
faqs.answer: Age alone is not the whole story, but panels from before the 1970s, and certain brands from the decades after, are worth an honest look no matter how they seem to run. Given how much of West Palm Beach's housing predates the mid century mark, this comes up often here.
